title: Nine Weeks of Feeding
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：chicken　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chicken 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 my mother was sent to feed ① chicken she could not catch, and she said the feeding was the whole of the lesson. The ② chicken, meaning the bird and not the meat, was nine weeks old and was fed by whoever came last; chicken, she said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chicken in that yard had the same leg, and the ④ chicken at the end, meaning the one the farmer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever fed properly. Chicken, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chicken was the whole of the dinner, meaning the meat it carried and not the bird. The ⑥ chicken, meaning the meat and not any of that, is the only thing in a dinner that everybody shares and nobody questions; chicken, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both a bird and a meat. She said the meat is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ chicken had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the leg. The ⑧ chicken of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine weeks and eleven years of feeding; chicken, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chicken I remember is the one at the end, which was fed in 1970 and is still described as the plumpest in the county. A ⑩ chicken, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being fed; every chicken, she said, is a meat that has agreed to look like a bird. She said the meat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 鸡（指那只活鸡本身，与那些鸡肉相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed a chicken 喂一只鸡
D. n. 鸡（指院子里每一只）
E. n. 鸡（指末尾那一只）
F. n. 鸡肉（抽象：它承载的那份肉食）
G. n. 那份肉食（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chicken, meaning the bird and not the meat
chicken was the whole of the dinner
the chicken had become a number in a report
The chicken of the whole thing
A chicken, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: feed a chicken 意为“喂一只鸡”，1950 年母亲被派去喂她抓不住的那只鸡。
chicken 意为“鸡”，指那只活鸡本身而不是那些鸡肉，九周大，由最后来的人喂。
chicken 指院子里每一只鸡，每一只都是同样的腿。
chicken 指末尾那一只（农户留下的那一只），是唯一有人认真喂过的。
chicken 意为“鸡肉”，抽象指它承载的那份肉食，父亲说 chicken 就是那顿饭的全部。
chicken 为抽象用法，指那份肉食本身，是一顿饭里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
chicken 意为“鸡”，到 1965 年这只 chicken 成了报告里的一个数字。
chicken 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九周和十一年的喂养。
chicken 意为“鸡”，我记得的是末尾那一只，1970 年喂过，至今仍被说成全县最肥的。
chicken 为抽象总称，祖母说一只鸡是唯一会因为被认真喂养而变好的东西。

answers: In 1950 my mother was sent to feed chicken she could not catch, and she said the feeding was the whole of the lesson.
The chicken, meaning the bird and not the meat, was nine weeks old and was fed by whoever came last.
Every chicken in that yard had the same leg.
The chicken at the end, meaning the one the farmer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever fed properly.
My father said chicken was the whole of the dinner, meaning the meat it carried and not the bird.
